GetFirstPlatformUserWithNoInputDevice
functions.docs:
Finds the first FPlatformUserId which was already allocated with no input devices.
Returns PLATFORMUSERID_NONE if every current platform user has a valid input device mapped to it.
Will not return the Unpaired platform user.

functions.name: IsUnpairedUserId
functions.docs: Returns true if the given Platform User Id is the user for unpaired input devices on this platform.

functions.name: IsInputDeviceMappedToUnpairedUser
functions.docs: Returns true if the given input device is mapped to the unpaired platform user id.

functions.name: GetPlatformUserForNewlyConnectedDevice
functions.docs:
Returns the platform user id that a newly connected device should be mapped to.
If "ShouldCreateUniqueUserForEachDevice" is true, then a new platform user id will be allocated for this device.
Otherwise, this will return the primary platform user.
@param InUserId		An optional user index which can be passed in. If this is not -1, and IsUsingControllerIdAsUserId is true,
then the platform user id for that user will be returned.

functions.name: GetUserForInputDevice
functions.docs: Returns the platform user attached to this input device, or PLATFORMUSERID_NONE if invalid

functions.name: GetPrimaryInputDeviceForUser
functions.docs: Returns the primary input device used by a specific player, or INPUTDEVICEID_NONE if invalid

functions.name: GetMaxPlatformUserCount
functions.docs:
Returns the max allowed number of platform users this platform can have.
By default, this will return the value specified in the input settings ini file

functions.name: HandleInputDevicePolicyChanged
functions.docs:
Remaps the currently connected input devices based on the new given policy. This property can only be changed
at editor time and should not be used at runtime.

functions.name: BindCoreDelegates
functions.docs:
Binds to any core delegates that the platform may broadcast. By default it is only the OnUserLoginChangedEvent delegate.
Called during the constructor of this device mapper.

functions.name: GetUserForUnpairedInputDevices
functions.docs:
Returns the platform user id that is being used for unmapped input devices.
Will be PLATFORMUSERID_NONE if platform does not support this (this is the default behavior)

functions.name: GetPrimaryPlatformUser
functions.docs:
Returns the 'Primary' Platform user for this platform.
This typically has an internal ID of '0' and is used as the default platform user to
map devices such as the keyboard and mouse that don't get assigned unique ID's from their
owning platform code.

functions.name: GetDefaultInputDevice
functions.docs: Returns the default device id used for things like keyboard/mouse input

IsUsingControllerIdAsUserId
functions.docs:
If true, this device mapper is operating in a backward compatible mode where there is a
1:1 mapping between controller id and user id

functions.name: ShouldBroadcastLegacyDelegates
functions.docs:
If true, than this device mapper will broadcast the older
CoreDelegates as well as the new delegates. Set this to
true if your platform needs calls from OnControllerConnectionChange or
OnControllerPairingChange

functions.name: AllocateNewUserId
functions.docs: Allocates a new user id when a user becomes active, will return none if no more can be created

functions.name: AllocateNewInputDeviceId
functions.docs: Returns the next available input device id. This ID should be globally unique!

functions.name: OnUserLoginChangedEvent
functions.signature: OnUserLoginChangedEvent(Target, Logged In, Raw Platform User Id, User Index)
functions.docs:
Callback for when FCoreDelegates::OnUserLoginChangedEvent is broadcasted.
If the user has logged out, then remap any input devices that the user had to the "Unpaired" user on this platform (if bUnpairInputDevicesWhenLoggingOut is true)
